verdict.rationale: Snowflake ships native 'dbt Projects on Snowflake' with vendor docs covering the full dbt lifecycle (develop/deploy/orchestrate/observe), a managed dbt Core/Fusion runtime, and an explicit migration guide from existing dbt Core projects — going beyond just a third-party adapter to first-class native support. Community evidence (comm-9) shows some real-world friction around auto-clustering interacting with dbt incremental full-refreshes, indicating a caveat rather than a dispute of the core capability. missing for 10: independent/hands-on adoption reports validating the native dbt Projects experience at scale, and detail on the classic dbt-snowflake adapter's parity/versioning docs.
